title: Why the Kanwar Yatra Turns Violent Every Year? #kanwaryatra #news
description:
🚨 This isn’t Bhakti. It’s a mob with saffron flags. Watch how Kanwariya “devotion” turns into street violence every year. From brutal assaults to political silence, we dig deep into the psychology, sociology, and political climate that enables this violence.

The Kanwar Yatra is celebrated as an act of devotion to Lord Shiva. But in recent years, it’s making headlines for all the wrong reasons—mob violence, vandalism, and intimidation in the name of faith.

In this explosive video, we expose why do peaceful pilgrims become violent mobs? What’s the role of religion, politics, and devotees in this transformation? And how can the society stop it?

The Kanwar Yatra 2025 has been in the spotlight for all the wrong reasons, with rising reports of Kanwariya mob violence, shocking cases of Kanwariya assault news, and disturbing headlines of Kanwar Yatra riots. Many cities are already bracing for Kanwar Yatra violence 2025, as stories of Kanwariya attack in Muzaffarnagar and Kanwar Yatra controversies flood the media. From Kanwariya road rage incidents to the broader issue of religious violence in India, these events expose how festivals can spiral into chaos.

This video takes an atheist perspective in India, unpacking the religion and mob mentality that fuels such unrest, while offering an atheist view on Kanwar Yatra that asks hard questions about faith and accountability. We examine Kanwar Yatra problems, give Kanwar Yatra news updates, and explore the Kanwar Yatra psychology that explains why Kanwariyas turn violent.

As part of our ongoing atheist documentary work in India, Pale Blue Thoughts shines a light on the Kanwariya mobs exposed, connects it with mob mentality explained, and critiques how Hindu festival violence often hides under the garb of tradition. By revealing the dark side of Kanwar Yatra, we emphasize why secularism in India is more important than ever.

⚠️ Watch till the end as we dismantle the myths around “Bhakti” and ask the hard questions no one dares to.
🔔 Subscribe for more fearless, atheist perspectives on faith and society.

#ThisIsNotBhakti #StopMobViolence #religionandpolitics
